title.en: Check the rules for your work

scope.en: Faculty and module instructions govern assessment AI use; only Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) via a protected UZH account are approved (secret data prohibited), and Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences assessment rules are faculty-scoped.
scope.zh: 各学院与模块说明决定考核中的AI使用；校方仅批准通过受保护UZH账号使用Copilot Chat（基础版）与Microsoft 365 Copilot（高级版）（严禁处理秘密级数据），哲学院（文学院）考核规定仅在该院范围内适用。

do.en: Check the current module syllabus and ask teaching staff where permission is unclear.
do.zh: 核对模块大纲，许可不明时向教师确认。

do.en: Indicate generative AI use in the required form for the assessment.
do.zh: 依考核要求披露生成式AI使用。

do.en: Use institution-protected Copilot with an official UZH account and respect data classification.
do.zh: 以UZH账号使用受保护Copilot并遵守数据分类。

dont.en: Do not assume a university-licensed tool is allowed in every assessment.
dont.zh: 不得把校方工具许可当成任何考核的AI许可。

dont.en: Do not process secret data in either Copilot version.
dont.zh: 不得在任何Copilot版本处理秘密级数据。

dont.en: Do not treat the faculty misconduct rule as a university-wide automatic sanction.
dont.zh: 不得将文学院违规规则扩展为全校自动处罚。
